margin_basis: A 2pp important-regression guard is approximately one true signed discovery per family in the51-alternative core design. It is NOT an improvement target, clinical threshold or publication criterion. Same guard applied to all10nonnull M0 scenes, not weakened post-result.
precision: Fixed1024 fullfamilies per scene. DEV paired SD roughly.05-.18; naive pointwise MCSE.16-.56pp before simultaneous protection. Use preregistered finite betting intervals, not those naive intervals. Expect roughly2-4pp simultaneous half-width depending variance; no guarantee of decisive outcome, no sample enlargement.
primary_acceptance: Full finite-model proof remains valid for complete algorithm; input assumptions no stronger than R2M0.
All13M0 primary FDR simultaneous upper endpoints<=.05; otherwise empirical confirmation not established even if proof exists.
Equal-weight core paired Power improvement lower endpoint>0 and all10nonnull M0 paired lower endpoints>=-.02. Also display every point/interval; no favorable scene deletion.

Practical usefulness assessed from actual gains/extra true discoveries/calibration need/runtime and all per-scene failures, not automatic from one statistically positive point. Report strong gap separately.
User PROVED_AND_USEFUL additionally requires a defensible distinct contribution. If priority/contribution remains unestablished, use an explicit qualified status, not full success.
boundary_acceptance: Keep both outside-M0 drifts. If either unprotected paired FDR R3minusR2 lower endpoint>0, set full_user_success_excluded_by_drift=true and do NOT label unqualified PROVED_AND_USEFUL; preserve loss, no drift rescue expansion. Upper<=0 supports nonincrease only for that fixed scene; interval crossing0 is UNRESOLVED, not no-worse. Both scenes must support nonincrease before declaring user clause15 verified empirically. Model gates/utility/novelty/boundary judgments separate. ExternalDelta5 requires its own M_Delta premise; FDR upper<=.05 tests consistency but CANNOT cancel default drift deterioration. No general drift guarantee.
history: R2C001 used only for R3 development. One R3 formal confirmation, no reserve; earlier R2/v1 confirmation histories unchanged. This .025 reporting budget does not claim simultaneous coverage across all historical phases.
stop: All15x1024 attempted once. No optional sample increase, confirmatory candidate switch, seed reroll or parameter edits. Retain failures. Evaluate after complete index only.
replay_audit: After all results, exactly replay cases0,1,5,10,14 rep0 from saved input and original algorithm seed; compare all R3 p/e/reference/decision arrays, R2/strong decisions and externalDelta5 arrays where applicable. This is reproducibility only, not five additional independent observations.
